text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, Biwa Hayahide and I watch<n>Narita Brian
run in a scrimmage,<n>whose incredible performance
leaves<n>me in shock.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide sees her younger self<n>in my
stunned expression. She sees<n>the little girl who
was overwhelmed<n>by her sister's speed, panicked,
and<n>got hurt.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She barely finishes her story when<n>Winning Ticket
and Narita Taishin, her<n>classmates and rivals, join
us.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
They're going to compete in the<n>Hopeful Stakes,
another junior G1<n>race. It looks like Narita Brian
isn't the<n>only tough competition around.
